yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.teaching: Poured-out love, poured-in hope. Month focus — Triumphant Love — Restoration & Eternity: Hope, harvest, thanksgiving. This week we carry "The End of the Matter" (Ecclesiastes 12:13). Physical Strength & Endurance flows from being loved first. Let Romans 5:5 settle you: Hope does not disappoint.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Strengthen this temple. Give me vitality and endurance to run my race to the crown.
days.declaration: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; divine health is my portion.
days.decree: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; divine health is my portion. Hope does not disappoint. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Walk 10 minutes praying the declaration; honour rest and water today.
